variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: a joke about Red Corwin, praise after the Wolves, a brush-off.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: I wonder who cuts Red Corwin's hair?

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Good work with the wolves, stranger! I hear old Ulric is very grateful!

variants.specifics: Dolgar: Three townsfolk of Dolgar: one fleeing leeches, one guarding his ore shed, one who distrusts surface folk.

rumour2.speaker: Miner
rumour2.text: Hey! Keep out of my ore shed!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Topsider! Bah! I've heard all about how your lot cheat us miners! Leave me be!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: Moggs panics, Elsbet swats gnats, Dabb boasts of holding the walkways.

rumour1.speaker: Moggs
rumour1.text: That does it! First the birds go quiet then the Ogres come. Run for the boats!

rumour2.speaker: Elsbet
rumour2.text: Shoo! These gnats won't leave me be!

rumour3.speaker: Dabb
rumour3.text: We've held the walkways! Now we must chase the Ogres out of the whole Gloamfen!

variants.specifics: Korlen: Gisla, an old townswoman; Fennick, a townsman; Marga, a flirt.

rumour1.speaker: Gisla
rumour1.text: I sense a dark storm gathering over Korlen! Can anyone save us now?

rumour2.speaker: Fennick
rumour2.text: Gruttock's Ogres are burning the farms outside the walls! Hurry, they need you out there!

rumour3.speaker: Marga
rumour3.text: My, my! You're a sight better looking than the lads in the garrison! Come and see me once you've finished with the Ogres.

variants.specifics: Ondel: Ardle at the door of the Net Hall, Grest the fisherman and Wilda, a fishwife.

rumour1.speaker: Ardle
rumour1.text: Welcome to the Net Hall. Mayor Wendrel's rooms are at the back.

rumour2.speaker: Grest
rumour2.text: Find Vulmar and throw him to the eels!

rumour3.speaker: Wilda
rumour3.text: How can a few fishermen fight off the dead? It's hopeless! Where can we go?

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Three townsfolk: a woman teasing the player, a student on the Ghosts, an old man on the times.

rumour1.speaker: Townswoman
rumour1.text: You're awful skinny for a monster-slayer. Hee, hee, hee...!

rumour2.speaker: Student
rumour2.text: Malgrith must have learned how to call up the dead. One night the hill stood empty, then the very next night it was crawling with Ghosts and Wisps! They were after the Orb of Seeing.

rumour3.speaker: Old Man
rumour3.text: No, we must not sleep while Malgrith's Ghosts walk the hills!

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: Three folk of Fort Skarra: Mirta by the cold hearth, Bettra who teases, Dolgo the bear trapper.

rumour1.speaker: Mirta
rumour1.text: Hey who let the fire go out?

rumour2.speaker: Bettra
rumour2.text: Shiver, little man, shiver! Hah, hah, hah...!

rumour3.speaker: Dolgo
rumour3.text: Greetings! My name is Dolgo. I hunt and trap the mountain bears to keep the high road safe for traders.

variants.specifics: Vurn: Pibble takes the player for a new smith, Brog's furnace is out again, Lissa rails against the traders of Tarvel.

rumour1.speaker: Pibble
rumour1.text: So you've come to join the smiths! Welcome to the guild! As makers of the town's steel, we carry a heavy load. I trust you'll do us proud at the anvil.

rumour2.speaker: Brog
rumour2.text: Well, there's the furnace gone out again. Can't forge, might as well go take a nap.

rumour3.speaker: Lissa
rumour3.text: The traders of Tarvel are a greedy and crooked pack of swindlers! Worst of all is that fat cheat, Grisold!

variants.specifics: Varrow: Hosk, Ebba and Quilp, townsfolk of Varrow, on the Urchins, Krull and the wolves.

rumour1.speaker: Hosk
rumour1.text: Somebody must deal with those Urchins! Smoke out their caves and bring back what they stole.

rumour2.speaker: Ebba
rumour2.text: There is a bandit chief -- Krull -- hiding up on Crag Hill. He is said to keep a whole chest of stolen gold under his bed!

rumour3.speaker: Quilp
rumour3.text: Don't give up hope yet, friend, the wolves will run from our torches!

variants.specifics: Tolm: Three townsfolk of Tolm: Pella, Nella and old Hobb.

rumour1.speaker: Pella
rumour1.text: Yaaaaagh! Get it out of my apron!

rumour2.speaker: Nella
rumour2.text: Oh, you're back. Have the Ogres been beaten, yet?

rumour3.speaker: Hobb
rumour3.text: Is it true what folks say about Ogres?
